limitations: Interaction is live; predictions are precomputed, sampled held-out evidence, not full-cloud inference.
Degraded views use fold-zero selected clean-variant predictions, not the separate fixed robust model used in the headline stress plot.
Some clean C2C predictions are unavailable on displayed V2 cores. Common saved support is reported explicitly; no new benchmark metric is calculated.
Local-only request blocking was tested; no system-wide network adapter settings were changed.
Region means are uncalibrated scores; point-label purity is not object precision or installed quantity.
